title: Code, synthetic data and derived real-data results for EV charging recovery under late delivery confirmation
description: Code, synthetic benchmark and derived results (ACN-Data, Palo Alto, Perth & Kinross sessions used for timing only) for the study of EV charging recovery after demand response when delivery confirmation arrives late. Code under MIT; results, docs and figures under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). Raw third-party session data are not redistributed.
